title: Refold consumer
spec: Add src/archive/refold.ts: refold(portfolio, fetchExport) → { agree: boolean, deals: { contract, published, refolded, agree }[] } re-running the fold on the exports the manifest names (digest-checked) and comparing status/counterparty/amount with what the publisher claims. A digest mismatch or a missing export is a disagreement, not an error. This is the auditor's 10 percent refold.
done: A faithful portfolio refolds to agree=true; a tampered status or export flips exactly that deal to agree=false.
